=== no such task
orchestrator: retry_task {"id":"T44","reason":"again"}
refusal:
there is no task 'T44' (the run has tasks T01 to T06)

=== the reason is empty
orchestrator: retry_task {"id":"T03"}
refusal:
the reason is empty

=== a waiting task
orchestrator: retry_task {"id":"T06","reason":"again"}
refusal:
T06 is pending; only a failed or cancelled task can be retried

=== a running task
orchestrator: retry_task {"id":"T05","reason":"again"}
refusal:
T05 is running; only a failed or cancelled task can be retried

=== a task that is being merged
orchestrator: retry_task {"id":"T02","reason":"again"}
refusal:
T02 is merging; only a failed or cancelled task can be retried

=== a done task
orchestrator: retry_task {"id":"T01","reason":"again"}
refusal:
T01 is done; only a failed or cancelled task can be retried

=== the tier is none of the three
orchestrator: retry_task {"id":"T03","reason":"again","tier":"deeper"}
refusal:
tier must be one of deep, standard, light

=== queued again
orchestrator: retry_task {"id":"T03","reason":"the fixture files are in testdata/ now"}
answer:
T03 is queued again as attempt 2 (standard), from a fresh checkout.

=== queued again by a chat: it depends on a cancelled task
chat: retry_task {"id":"T04","reason":"the user wants the notes"}
answer:
T04 is queued again as attempt 2 (standard), from a fresh checkout. Note: it depends on T03 (cancelled) and will not start until that is retried and done, or the dependency is removed.

=== refused for a chat
chat: retry_task {"id":"T04","reason":"again"}
refusal:
T04 is pending; only a failed or cancelled task can be retried

=== queued again on a higher tier
orchestrator: retry_task {"id":"T03","reason":"it was  too hard\nfor its agent","tier":"deep"}
answer:
T03 is queued again as attempt 3 (deep), from a fresh checkout.

=== queued again, in a run without git
orchestrator: retry_task {"id":"T01","reason":"now"}
answer:
T01 is queued again as attempt 2 (standard).
